# Native feasibility study
The required scope is module resolution, symbol identity and diagnostics. No substantive port before the feasibility result.
The checked inventory.json is authoritative for accessible public corpora, available runners and an independent verifier already assigned by the owner. All three runners are required for qualification; none has been exercised yet.
The research proposal is at most two compositions, two correction passes each and five engineer-days; this effort budget is not approved. Only the user may commit this budget. A one-day spike is possible but does not qualify feasibility.
The public corpora in inventory.json are approved for use. A private representative corpus is also proposed but has no data-owner approval. The user must choose public-only with a representativeness limit, or provide an approved private snapshot before private-data work. Do not infer access permission.
Inventorying the obligations and preparing a protocol are independent of those decisions. Choosing a local document format and inventory order is delegated.
